page.overview:
Who is Bistahieversor?

(meaning "Bistahi destroyer"), also known as the "Bisti Beast", is a genus of eutyrannosaurian tyrannosauroid theropod dinosaur that lived in New Mexico during the Late Cretaceous period. First described in 1990 as a specimen of Aublysodon, it would receive its name 20 years later. A study paper in 2025 recovered Bistahieversor as a member of the Albertosaurines alongside .

This theropod hails from the Kirtland Formation, which housed ceratopsians like Pentaceratops as well as hadrosaurs like Anasazisaurus, Kritosaurus, Parasaurolophus, and Naashoibitosaurus.

Bistahieversor is among the dinosaurs that you could find in the game.

Bistahieversor has been confirmed to appear in Jurassic World: Dino Trackers. This will be the first time it has ever physically appeared in the Jurassic Park Franchise and as well as a toy.
